prompts.prompt-r1.txt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Jason D's Vision Spain location master source, wide landscape
Primary request: Create an original photorealistic artistic interpretation of the old town of San Cristóbal de La Laguna, Tenerife, at 24 September 2026 01:30 Atlantic/Canary.
Scene/backdrop: Pedestrian Calle Obispo Rey Redondo near Plaza de la Concepción, eye-level looking west-southwest toward Iglesia de la Concepción.
Subject and geometry: tall square volcanic-stone bell tower with stacked arched openings and modest crown, low colourful Canarian historic façades with dark timber balconies, straight pedestrian street showing the UNESCO unfortified grid.
Style/medium: highly realistic contemporary travel photography aesthetic, restrained and documentary, realistic stone, stucco and timber.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9-friendly source with complete bell tower and street, generous margins, central tower suitable for portrait crop.
Lighting/mood: deep night, 23.5°C, partly cloudy 51%, dry, light wind. Restrained warm street-level ambient lamps and cool clouded sky; no dramatic floodlighting.
Constraints: quiet empty street; no people, cars, shop signs, legible text, festival decoration, flags, moon, stars, wet pavement, rain, text overlay, signature, watermark, or border. Do not invent cathedral-scale domes or fortification walls.
